caption: The wall switch in a lit hallway is flipped down, and the ceiling light goes off.

sa.check: A wall switch in a hallway; the hallway is lit at the start.
The order is lit, flip, off.

pc.expect: The light goes off at the moment the switch moves, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch moves and the light stays on; or the light goes off before the switch is touched; or it goes off long after with nothing else happening.

pc.expect: Once off, the light stays off for the rest of the clip; the hallway stays as dark as the loss of that light makes it.
pc.fail: The light comes back on by itself; or flickers between on and off; or the hallway brightens again with no other source.

pc.expect: The illumination disappears with the fixture: the walls and floor under it go dimmer and its shadows vanish.
pc.fail: The fixture goes dark while the hallway stays as bright; or the hallway darkens while the fixture still glows; or light remains pooled on the floor under a dark fixture.

pc.expect: Nothing else changes at the flip.
pc.fail: Objects move or doors open when the switch is flipped; or the switch moves back by itself; or the fixture swings.

pc.expect: One switch and one light, both staying in place; the hand does not pass through the wall.
pc.fail: A second switch appears; or the fixture vanishes rather than going dark; or the hand passes into the wall; or doors appear or vanish in the dark.

pc.expect: The hallway keeps its colours and contents apart from brightness.
pc.fail: Walls change colour; or pictures change; or the fixture changes shape.
